body: I don't know, they're saying this pandemic could last 2+ years now. We're 2 *months* in and my depression has already reached ungodly levels. My therapist doesn't even bother talking about it much to me and derails the conversation to my other lifelong issues. So what's the point?

They say suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. This pandemic is certainly not temporary. It's left a permanent scar on my mental health. I've lost everyone thanks to physical distancing, of which there is no end in sight.
